blocks.text: Electric potential difference woh work (kaam) hai jo aik charge ko do points ke darmiyan le jane mein har aik unit charge par karna parta hai. Isay yun likhte hain:

blocks.alt: Oopar musbat plate aur neeche manfi plate, darmiyan neeche ki taraf mutawazi field lines E. Test charge qo (+) manfi plate ke qareeb nuqte A aur musbat plate ke qareeb nuqte B ke darmiyan; sabz teer A se B ki taraf harkat dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.1: Charged plates ke darmiyan yaksan (uniform) electric field; test charge qo ko A se B le jaya gaya (kitab ki Figure 16.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Yahan W_AB woh work hai jo test charge q₀ ko A se B tak le jane mein hota hai, aur ΔU potential energy mein izafa hai. Is ki SI unit volt hai:

Yani 1 volt ka matlab hai 1 coulomb charge par 1 joule work. Volt ko asaani se kilovolt (1 kV = 1000 V) ya millivolt (1 mV = 0.001 V) mein badal sakte hain. Potential difference aur electric field ka rishta yeh hai:
Is ka matlab yeh hai ke electric field batata hai ke faasle (distance) ke saath potential kitni tezi se badalta hai:

Minus ka nishan batata hai ke field hamesha zyada potential se kam potential ki taraf hota hai (jaise pani oonchai se neeche behta hai). Agar field uniform (har jagah barabar) ho to yeh rishta aur saada ho jata hai:

Is se pata chalta hai ke do points ka potential difference field ki taqat aur un ke darmiyan faasle, dono ke seedha mutabiq (directly proportional) hai. Field jitna taqatwar, potential utni tezi se girta hai. Yun field aur voltage ka aapas mein saaf rishta samajh aata hai.

blocks.title: Example 16.1
blocks.problem: 6 volt ki battery do parallel copper plates se jori gayi hai jin ke darmiyan 0.3 cm faasla hai. Plates ke darmiyan electric field intensity nikalein.
steps: Diya gaya: ΔV = 6 V, Δd = 0.3 cm = 0.003 m (cm ko 100 se taqseem kar ke metre banaya).
blocks.answer: E = 2000 N C⁻¹ (yahi 2000 V m⁻¹ bhi hai)

blocks.title: For your information
blocks.text: Hum ne infinity (bohat door) wale points ko zero potential par mana hai, lekin amli taur par zameen (Earth) ko zero potential par mana jata hai. Is liye kisi point ka absolute potential zameen ke hawale se napa jata hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Fig. 16.1 mein oopar wali plate positive aur neeche wali negative hai, is liye field E oopar se neeche hai. Positive test charge q₀ ko A se B (field ke ulat, oopar ki taraf) le jane mein work karna parta hai; isi liye B ka potential A se zyada hai.

blocks.prompt: E = −ΔV/Δd mein minus ka nishan kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke electric field us taraf hota hai jidhar potential kam hota hai, yani zyada potential se kam potential ki taraf. Agar Δd field ki simt mein lein to ΔV negative aata hai, aur minus laga kar E positive milta hai.

items: V = V_B − V_A = W_AB/q₀ = ΔU/q₀; 1 V = 1 J/1 C.
E = −ΔV/Δd: field zyada se kam potential ki taraf; uniform field mein E = V/d.
Amli taur par zameen ko zero potential mana jata hai.
